To prevent fraud and financial crime effectively, we need to understand likely entities and relevant behavioural patterns across events, while maintaining a high bar for privacy, governance, reliability, and explainability.&nbsp;The Identity Platform develops shared capabilities that help Adyen understand which events and identifiers may belong to the same underlying person or actor. These capabilities serve multiple downstream teams and use cases, including real-time fraud prevention, AML detection, investigations, and future risk products.</p> <p>You will help design and build the ML systems that make this possible. This includes applied modelling, large-scale data processing, low-latency serving, clear interfaces for downstream consumers, and the operational controls required for a platform used across teams.</p> <p>This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will influence long-term technical direction while remaining close to implementation, experimentation, and production systems.</p> <p><strong>In this role, you will:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Research, design, implement, train, deploy and monitor machine learning algorithms, either for batch prediction or real-time.
